title: ALL SKINFOLK AIN'T KINFOLK: CHILDREN OF DARKNESS

sense.text: “For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh”. My kinsmen according to the flesh: my kinfolk. All skinfolk ain't kinfolk. Today we delve into the mind of the house negro, the children of darkness. They have always been around since the beginning of time, and enemies as well.

“Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises”. Paul was an Israelite. He was not a Roman; that is another ridiculous doctrine. Paul was an Israelite with Roman citizenship.
“Whose are the fathers”: the promises pertain to the fathers. “And of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came”: Christ came for his kinsmen according to the flesh.

“Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel”. That is why this matters. People say, you guys teach that only Israel is going to be saved. True, but not all of them. We do not teach that all Israelites are going to be saved because they are Israelites, because of their nationality.

A lot of our people are not going to make it despite being Israelites. A lot of them are going to be destroyed. A lot of them are just as much heathen as the heathen.

“Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel”. These adversaries are the heathen. Remember, at this time we were in exile. We were allowed to return from exile, but we were not ruling: we were under Persian subjugation, Persian colonization.

They came “to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.” These heathen were placed in the land in the time of Assyria. Now they say: we serve your God like you do, we want to build with you, we want to be around you, we want to cleave.

But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and our elders, the chief of the fathers, said: “Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.” We don't need you heathens to help us. We got this on our own. We don't desire your help. Our forefathers in the captivity of Persia understood that solidarity and unity was paramount; we needed no heathen assistance, especially at that time.

It is the same now. As this truth spreads and grows, it is growing dangerous to them. It is not hidden any more; in some places it is trending on social media, so it is hard to blacklist us, hard to blackball us, hard to hide us. The heathen are going to take notice of us, and at some point they will outlaw this truth, ban these teachings or make them illegal. They are already doing it behind closed doors so it cannot spread as much as it is now.

And while we try to bring wisdom and knowledge to our people scattered abroad over all the earth, there are Israelites who have taken it on themselves to grant salvation to the other nations while we are in captivity: inviting salvation to nations whose salvation is not necessary, trying to find a suitable place or position of authority for our enemies while we are in hell, which is captivity. Our hell is their heaven and our heaven is their hell. There is a house negro spirit growing in the doctrine, growing in the movement, because fear is setting in.

“Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building”. See what happened when we said, no, we don't want your help, we don't want you around us: they went to the authorities to stop us from reconstructing, from rebuilding our temple.

precepts.why:
Esdras gives the same answer: “It is not for us and you to build together an house unto the Lord our God. We ourselves alone will build unto the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians hath commanded us.” We ourselves alone. We don't need your assistance; we good over here.

Right now we are a people of exile. We are under heathen subjugation, scattered abroad, lost in darkness: we don't know who we are, where we are from, or who our God is. Look at the comments under the captains' videos on New Year and Christmas: our people are so gone. Oh, we can't celebrate nothing then, everything's pagan. They sound like straight house negroes. If they can't do what massa says, they feel all hope is lost; they can't see a world without this man. And now there are Israelites coming into the truth pushing the same agenda: what about massa, where's he going to be when we get the kingdom? In the world that is post-traumatic slave disorder, and that is understood. But brothers coming to the truth trying to save these people in hell, trying to save your enemy who is in heaven while you are in his hell, and then inviting him into your heaven too?

“But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”, because they were rejected and told no. You know how Esau gets when he is told no: he turns into a different beast. He smiles, his voice gets real calm: what do you mean, no? He is not used to being told no by us. And it is not a black and white thing: all nations think that way. East Indians, Arabs, Asians all raise their children to understand that black folks are beneath them. Hire them, don't marry them. Sleep with them, but don't bring them home. Let them crack the door open and look inside, and that's about it, unless they bend over a little; then let them in the basement. That's you, house negroes, from the poorest to the richest.

In Godfather of Harlem, Bumpy Johnson decides to stop selling and rebuild Harlem with his own money: housing, a casino, a community that is self-sufficient. The Italian boss, Chin Gigante, wants to go 50-50 with him, then 60-40, and when Bumpy says no, he says: I'm not asking you, I'm telling you; we're involved in everything. Whenever black folks thrive and build on our own, the heathen come and destroy it: Black Wall Street in Tulsa, Rosewood, Seneca Village in Central Park, Black Bottom in Detroit, Chocolate City, Lake Lanier, a black town now mysteriously underwater. In the movie Rosewood they were mad that a black man had a piano, while we were in slavery. Then you got Israelites coming along: yeah, you can have a piano too, master.

“And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building”. Secret plots are passing laws, redlining, blackballing, segregation, Jim Crow: systematic laws set up so black folks don't thrive again, because left to ourselves we rebuild. The Most High had it planned that way: segregation was the best thing for us; integration destroyed us, and our forefathers knew it. When we were ruling in our righteousness, keeping the commandments of God, having heathens among us as our servants and subjects to learn our laws made sense. But at our worst, dispersed, exiled and scattered, we taught the laws again. In exile from Rome, from the Holy Roman Empire run by black kings with white man brains, we fled into Europe and the Caucasus Mountains, and Esau was there. We taught him our way of life and how to keep the commandments; he destroyed us, then he became us. We ran to Africa from the same white man, had our kingdoms and realms, and Muhammad the Arab came along; we gave him the law, and he enslaved and destroyed us.

So what is the pattern? When you are in exile, you do not share your wisdom with the other nations. It does not benefit you, because it is not the time for that. The time is to keep the commandments of God and the faith of his Son, so we gain favour with our God and get out of this condition; then deal with the nations after that. Our forefathers long after Ezra's time thought differently, and Israelites thinking the same way now are putting us in the same boat again.

Popular persuasions today are Christianity, social media, politics and philosophies, which go into the holidays: New Year's Eve, Christmas, Halloween, Easter. Islam, politics, money, podcasters, social media, content creators: popular persuasions. “So they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.” They disrupted the building the best way they could, because their plan was never to join us. Their plan was to join, infiltrate and destroy from the inside. If you really believed in helping us, why go through all this to stop the building?

Like the Black Panthers. First they allowed feminist black women in there, lesbians; the black feminist woman is the white man with breasts and melanin, the white man's drone, his greyhound, his brown hound. Then white folks came in afterwards, and it was a wrap. Same with Martin King: he didn't write the I Have a Dream speech; the Israelis wrote that speech for him, because they were in his circle. In the end he said to Harry Belafonte, I feel like I've integrated my people into a burning house. The mountaintop speech was his own, a speech of regret for not doing what is said right here: we ourselves will build. The road to hell is paved with good intentions. He went through hell to get us civil privileges, and he is applauded for that, but to our detriment; in the long run he realized the house is burning, and you are better off outside the house than watching it burn.

sense.text:
“When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.” It always bothered the nations whenever a brother, or a sister, rose up for the welfare and love of their people. Harriet Tubman, Sojourner Truth, Queen Kahina, a Levite princess who fought against the Arabs, the sisters and abolitionists who helped us to the Underground Railroad. Fred Hampton, Huey P. Newton, Denmark Vesey, Medgar Evers, Nat Turner, Marcus Garvey, Gabriel Prosser, Dessalines, Toussaint Louverture; among the Native Americans, Hatuey, Geronimo and others. The list goes on and on.

These people sought the welfare of their own, and whenever that took place the nations came to infiltrate and destroy, or as J. Edgar Hoover called it, to neutralize. Four Ds: defame, discredit, divide, destroy. In Judas and the Black Messiah, jail does not work, because it makes them martyrs; they teach in jail, get out, and the movement continues. So they killed Fred Hampton.

It grieves them the same today. The ones in the comments mocking, saying go Lakers, we was kangs, are house negroes who come in to disrupt because they fear these things. It is Esau's fear tactic: when they are afraid of us, when they feel intimidated by men speaking eloquently, they resort to mockery and jokes. That is what chore boys do. But when Christ returns there will be plenty of chores for them, forever, until they are of no use and eradicated from existence.

“Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.” The Most High put us into the hands of our oppressors.

“Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.” And Esau mocks us as violent. A man went speaking at schools saying black people are violent and gang violence is out of control, and a white man shot him in the neck. Who's violent now?
“Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it”.

“And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins”. We were being colonized: Jerusalem was colonized by the Persians, and Persia had power over the produce we produced in our own land. “Also they have dominion over our bodies”: we understood then that despite certain freedoms from the Persian king, we were not free, not ruling, not in authority. They had dominion over our bodies, as it is this day. That has not changed.

Israel was not meant to be in captivity, but this condition is the consequence of our own actions against our God and against each other, as verse 30 says. So our concern should not be other people. It should be us, because we are the reason behind our condition today. We are the answer to our own problems. We don't need to invite the heathen among us for any reason. Fix us first; what are you fixing them for?

“And over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.” Despite the Persian king giving us liberty to rebuild the temple, they still told us when to work and when not to work, when to build and when not to build. That's not freedom. That's permission. We don't have civil rights; we have civil privileges that can be given or taken away with an executive order at any time. We were not brought here to be free and be rewarded for our captivity.

The reward is watching America burn: the nations destroyed and us conquering them when Christ returns. That's reparations. That's restitution. Not forty acres and a mule: forty acres and the planet, all the acres, all the mules, all the cattle, when the earth belongs to you. Wanting the money is short-sighted; we think small, because the world belongs to us. If the negro is destroyed, where would that money go back to? And the white man that despises you will not reward you with anything: he gave you rap music and a black president who passed gay laws, and that was your reparations. He will tell you the Hamites and the Arabs captured you and sold you, go get money from them first; the Spanish and the Portuguese were first, the British were last in line, and the Israelis owned the slave ships.

“For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.” Mordecai sought the welfare, the wealth, of his people, while he was under the rule and subjugation of king Ahasuerus, Xerxes the first. Him and his cousin Esther, whom he raised: Esther is another example, a noble sister. Deborah is another one who sought the welfare of her people.

“They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed estate of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary.” From Babylon to Persia to Greece to Rome, there was always a brother, an Israelite, who would rise up for the welfare of his people. Here it is Mattathias and his sons, Judas Maccabeus, Eleazar, Joannan, Jonathan and Simon: these men sought the welfare and care of their people.

When we do that, we're racist, a black radical hate group. When white folks do that, they're white nationalists, and that's okay. Why? They don't want to see us unite.

precepts.why: “For it is better for us to die in battle, than to behold the calamities of our people and our sanctuary.” Same thing: the Maccabees would rather die fighting for their people than watch their calamities. That is seeking the welfare of your own.

sense.text: “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”.

“So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.” That, brothers and sisters, is called racial anger: seeing ourselves oppressed and crushed always, whether in our own land or outside of it. The things you see will upset you: your people's condition, their mindsets today, how degenerate we have become over a few generations. We are the worst we have ever been in the history of our existence; Israel is the worst now than ever. Generation Z is the last letter of the alphabet. This generation is finished.

That is why we must be united on our own. Leave these Americanized, Romanized negroes to themselves, and those of us who repent as Israelites come together and show a good example, so those still in the American mindset may repent also and come into the flock. As long as they are out there, they are him. Like Morpheus told Neo in The Matrix: if you're not one of us, you're one of them. In the world you are his robot, his puppet, with no mind of your own. Your opinion is Caucasian opinion; your mind is television, philosophy and social media. Red pill, blue pill, whatever pill you want to call it, there is Caucasoid influence behind it.

“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad”. We read it earlier in the curses. The key word is wise man, because a wise man knows when he is oppressed. A foolish man believes even under oppression that he is still free, and that is the house negro: best clothes, best food, room and board in the house, close to massa in massa's circles. I eats good, I dress good, I make six figures; you in the field are playing victim, you're racial idolaters. That's what the house negroes say.

“And a gift destroyeth the heart.” A gift: a record deal, a six-figure job, a fancy house, a contract, endorsements, a podcast, YouTube monetization, TikTok, IG. Christmas, Thanksgiving, Sunday, New Year's: those are the gifts, the time off you get in slavery. Obama was your gift, called a black Moses, and that gift passed gay laws using your civil rights against you. The rights you fought and died for, got dogs sicced on you for, got beaten and spat on and humiliated for, the sodomites got for free. And how is Chicago doing?

In Trick Baby, liberals and conservatives in a house full of white folks talk about letting us in or keeping us out, while black people serve the food. Those serving the food are the broken-in negroes of today: urban apologists, content creators blue pill or red pill, black Christians, politicians. Only the smart ones we move up: smart translates to the talented, the athletes, actors, rappers and content creators they can use to keep the negroes in line and inspired so long as they control them. Black celebrities have managers, which means they are managed; they have no freedom.

If we leave a smart one in the ghetto, he might develop into a leader against us; raise him into white society and you neutralize him. So the content creators from the streets reach a tax bracket close to higher-level white folks, defend Trump, cry over Charlie Kirk, and say nothing when their brother is hung from a tree five days later or their sister is shot in the face by a police officer in her own house for saying the Lord rebuke you. He loses his identity and his racial anger, if he has any, and to be a leader requires racial anger: oppression makes a wise man mad, and a wise man can become a leader. He becomes worthless to his brothers and safe for them. They use his smarts to write lyrics that destroy us, and use her to wind her hips and inspire young girls to do the same. Malcolm X said black people are the only ones whose leaders are court jesters, comedians and actors.

In his love for the creature comforts, except for his color, he becomes one of them. Creature comforts: the fancy car, women, fame, fortune, high income, record deals, a 21-bedroom house, fifty cars, white friends, a gated community where only white folks live, a white wife or a white husband. He's assimilated.

precepts.why:
“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”. That is our people who sought creature comforts and sought to be like the nations.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”: when danger comes, we're going to be good, we're going to be safe. That was Diddy's thought. Is he safe now? He thought the scourge had passed over him.

“For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”, until he is no longer valuable. Jay-Z: a smart man, a very smart man. But when you make a deal with the devil, that contract is temporary. That is what a gift does to the heart.

sense.text:
We are not going to put the blame on the white man or any other nation, because our people were a problem before the white man came along. We were evil and stupid back in Moses' time in the wilderness and we are evil and stupid now, just worse.

“Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian” is Alexander the Greek. This is where the white man gained supremacy on the earth, as the Greeks.
“So Alexander reigned twelve years”. He conquered the known world and the dark nations by the time he was twenty, and he died at thirty-two.
“And his servants bare rule every one in his place.” The men who were raised under him all took over when he died.

“And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.” When you are surrounded by Edom, evil multiplies. When Edom reigns on the earth evil is always there; it just multiplies and becomes worse. When the Europeans are involved it is enhanced and given excuse: laws are passed to spread the evil further, same-sex homosexuality, abortion. Evil is now embraced and made law.

Now Trump comes along trying to fix it, make it great again. You can't. America reaches 250 years old in July this year, and every major empire's lifespan is on average about 250 years; the Mamluks lasted longer, but the exception does not change the rule. At that mark an empire goes into the age of decadence, where it unravels, and the earliest signs of decline are feminism, homosexuality, entertainment and distraction. The more masculine and traditional empires, Russia and China with their nukes, and Iran in alliance with them, see America getting weak. You can't fight America one on one, so they will jump it: the European Union, Russia, Iran and China with bombs. You can't stop nukes by shooting them; some will get through, in thirty minutes, or eight to ten if hypersonic.

precepts.why: When the Greeks came into power, the evils of our people, already there in Moses' time, multiplied. “Then certain ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower”. Our people who hated their own people ran to massa to tell on our brother Jonathan, who loved his people. Rats.

sense.text: “Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel”: this is spoken to Israelites in our own land, before the evils multiplied when the Europeans came into power. “For the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land”: the Lord has an issue with the inhabitants, which is us in our land, “because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.” No mercy or kindness among our people. We were being evil.

“By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.” Brother kills brother. Brother kills sister. Sister kills sister. Blood toucheth blood.

“Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.” I'm going to take away all your resources; I'll have the heathen come in and destroy you and take your possessions, because of all the evil you are doing among yourselves.

Black folks love to point the finger: the white man made us evil. No. Evil was always among us. It just multiplied when we got around this man.

precepts.why:
Even in the Israelite nation you got evil negroes. “But they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them. And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey”: I will give their land into the hands of other nations, because we were sacrificing to idols, worshipping other gods, violating God's laws. “And to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it”: the wicked of the earth is Edom, the European man, and the other nations, starting with the Babylonians.

“My face will I turn also from them”: you ask for my help, I'm not listening; I turn my back on you. “For the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.” The robbers are still there; they call themselves Israelis today. Imagine a robber who robs your house and never leaves: he posts up, puts his pictures up, puts you in the basement, and when someone asks about the picture of the black man on the wall, he says that's me, I had a tan that day.

“Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.” Make a chain means established judgment. What is crime? Sin. So we became a nation of criminals, and when you are a criminal you get incarcerated. We are still serving our sentence today. Some will stay in prison till it burns; some of us will get out on good behaviour, keeping God's commandments. Our cities were full of violence, Baltimore, Chicago, Memphis, New York, DC, before any European influence. We are the answer to our own problems.

“Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses”: the worst of all the nations he made. We know who that is; he rules over us now, and he possesses our lands, our people, our identity. “I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease”: our pride. We were prideful: God ain't going to do nothing to us, we're going to be in this land forever. God was like, word, watch me cook.

“Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.” We will seek equality and rights, and there will be none. We were rebellious then, and we are worse now.

“Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.” We ripped the coats off people and stole them; we robbed each other at sword point, at knife point. Take it off, give me your coat.

Does that sound familiar? Nothing new today: see something you got on I like, I'm going to take it. Your car, your clothes, your woman, your man. And this was before European influence.

sense.text: Shemaiah told Nehemiah, “Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee”. Let's go hide; they're going to try to kill you; I'll protect you.
“Should such a man as I flee?” I ain't going nowhere. I'm not hiding from nobody. “I will not go in.”
“And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him”: Nehemiah realized this man was giving him bad counsel. “For Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.” This brother was hired by the heathen.

“Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.” He was hired to make Nehemiah hide in the temple and look cowardly in front of the people, to defame his character as a leader. The four Ds.

“My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works”: these Ammonites and Moabites. “And on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.” The prophetess Noadiah is the black woman. So they got the black man and the black woman hired to turn Nehemiah against the Lord. They were hired, paid off: creature comforts.

“In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab”. When the creature comforts come and they do well, Israelites start to marry outside their race. Remember, this was on a small scale.

“And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language”. The children were raised up by their mothers, and the mother is the first teacher of the house. They could not speak Hebrew; they spoke the language of their mothers. The child is black, but raised in a heathen mindset.

“And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair”. Nehemiah fought with them, cursed them, punched some of them in the face: he was throwing hands with these dudes, and he won those fights. He made them swear by God by putting his hands on them: “Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.”
“Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things?” Among many nations there was no king like him, beloved of his God, “nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.”

“And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite”, the same Sanballat who hired Shemaiah and the prophetess Noadiah to take Nehemiah out. “Therefore I chased him from me.”
“Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites”, by marrying heathen women.

“Thus cleansed I them from all strangers”. Nehemiah got rid of them, because these children are racially compromised. There are Israelites today with heathen mothers, grandmothers and aunts on their mother's side and Jacob on the father's side, but because they were raised around the heathen side and the father was not around, their allegiances are flawed.

Drake is racially compromised, primarily raised by his mama. Vin Diesel has a black father, but won't say he's a black man: I'm a man of color. The Rock's father is a black man, but he leans more to his mother's side. Halle Berry's mother told her what you see in the mirror is what you are. Tiger Woods: I'm not black, I'm Cablinasian; a negro on his father's side. A content creator who runs her mouth, with a Nigerian father and a white mother, cried over Charlie Kirk. Racially compromised.

“This Simon now, of whom we spake afore, having been a bewraye of the money, and of his country, slandered Onias”, and called him a traitor, though Onias “tendered his own nation, and was so zealous of the laws.” Simon was trying to get Onias, a righteous high priest, taken out so he could replace him.
“Jason the brother of Onias laboured underhand to be high priest”, and eventually he had Onias killed. Simon is one house negro; Jason is the other.
“For he built gladly a place of exercise under the tower itself, and brought the chief young men under his subjection, and made them wear a hat.” The place of exercise is the gym.

“Now such was the height of Greek fashions, and increase of heathenish manners, through the exceeding profaneness of Jason, that ungodly wretch, and no high priest”, that the priests left the altar to be partakers in the place of exercise, “after the game of Discus called them forth”. That is the Olympics. The Greeks introduced the Olympics to us, and basketball and football are an extension of it.

“Not setting by the honours of their fathers, but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all.” We didn't care about our forefathers any more. We enjoyed the glory of the white man, the Greeks, more than anything else.

“By reason whereof sore calamity came upon them”: the sore calamity came upon us from the same man we worshipped, “for they had them to be their enemies and avengers, whose custom they followed so earnestly, and unto whom they desired to be like in all things.”

In all things, even our own facial features: we mess up our nose, bleach our skin, wear blonder hair. Our sisters in Africa scrape their skin until it comes off lighter; and when they stop, the pigmentation comes back. Sammy Sosa, praise white Jesus.

“Three years afterward Jason sent Menelaus, the aforesaid Simon’s brother, to bear the money unto the king”, and Menelaus “got the priesthood to himself, offering more than Jason by three hundred talents of silver.” He undermined Jason for the high priesthood that they had stolen from Onias. Simon, Jason, Menelaus: all terrible traitors of their own people, and they were killing us too.

precepts.why:
“Now when there was gone forth a false rumour, as though Antiochus had been dead, Jason took at the least a thousand men, and suddenly made an assault upon the city”. When Antiochus was rumoured dead, Jason took the opportunity to go on a rampage against his own people. “Menelaus fled into the castle”: Jason attacked Menelaus, who had undermined him for the priesthood.

“But Jason slew his own citizens without mercy, not considering that to get the day of them of his own nation would be a most unhappy day for him; but thinking they had been his enemies, and not his countrymen, whom he conquered.” Jason started killing his own people, us, wholesale. He did not see us as his people. He saw himself as a Greek who wanted power and authority, and that is what happens when you seek a power and authority that is not meant for you to have. Jason was the worst.

sense.text: “Then they that were with Maccabeus made supplication, and besought God that he would be their helper; and so they ran with violence upon the strong holds of the Idumeans”: fighting the Europeans.
“And assaulting them strongly, they won the holds”, and “killed no fewer than twenty thousand.” We won.

“Nine thousand, were fled together into two very strong castles, having all manner of things convenient to sustain the siege”: the nine thousand who got away fortified themselves so they could survive.
“Maccabeus left Simon and Joseph, and Zaccheus also, and them that were with him, who were enough to besiege them”: you take over and kill these, we'll be back.

“Now they that were with Simon, being led with covetousness, were persuaded for money, through certain of those that were in the castle, and took seventy thousand drachms, and let some of them escape.” The ones who fled into the castles bribed them: let us escape and we'll pay you.
Maccabeus “accused those men, that they had sold their brethren for money, and set their enemies free to fight against them.” They sold out their brothers for money.
“So he slew those that were found traitors”. That is what they did to traitors back then: killed them. Traitors get death.

precepts.why:
Here comes another one: Simon, Jason, Menelaus, and now Rhodocus. “But Rhodocus, who was in the Jews’ host, disclosed the secrets to the enemies”. He was among us, an informant, like some sitting in here telling the heathen what is going on with us.

“Therefore he was sought out, and when they had gotten him, they put him in prison.” He was discovered and caught, and we threw him in prison where he belongs.

sense.text: So you always have people making a covenant with hell and death, even then up until now. “If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

“We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?” I'm not in slavery. I'm free. I make money, I do well for myself, I own four cars and a bunch of real estate; y'all negroes is playing victim. That's what the creature comfort negroes, the content creators, say.

sense.text: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?”

“The kings of the earth set themselves”: the kings of the earth are the nations. “And the rulers take counsel together”: the rulers are people in the pockets, in the creature comforts, of white supremacy, heathen supremacy. “Against the Lord, and against his anointed”: against Christ and his followers.

“Let us break their bands asunder”: let's defame them, mock them, make them look bad, say they're a hate group, say they're racial idolaters. “And cast away their cords from us”: stop their teachings.

precepts.why:
“But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake”. The rulers are our people, and the kings are the heathen, like Herod and the Caesars, Nero.

“For a testimony against them”: against the heathen, and against our own people, through the scriptures.

“But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.” Kings like Agrippa; rulers like the Pharisees, the Sadducees and the scribes.

sense.text: “Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.”

“For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.” He covered their eyes. They were evil and rebellious back then, and evil and rebellious now.

precepts.why: “The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.” The builders are the rulers. Who are the builders? The rulers whose eyes he covered in darkness, because they were wicked as hell.

“Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.” The table is the Bible. Let the Bible be a trap and a snare for the wicked of my people.

“Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not”: that is the elders, the leaders, the rulers. “And make their loins continually to shake”: their minds are lost. They read the Bible and can't understand what they are reading, because they are too rebellious and evil.

“Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them. Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents. For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten”: that's Christ. “And they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded”: they speak evil of him whom God smote and wounded.

sense.text: “But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord arose against his people, till there was no remedy.”

precepts.why: “I sent unto you my servants the prophets, whom ye have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, saith the Lord.” We tortured our prophets, killed them and tore them in pieces. So we killed the prophets.

Watch what Stephen says to the rulers: “Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.” The Holy Ghost has been around since Moses' time, and they resisted him as their fathers did in Moses' time.

“Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One”. He told the elders, the builders of that time, that they were the children of the murderers who killed the prophets that prophesied of Christ in the Old Testament, who tore them in pieces before Christ even came. “Of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers”: your fathers killed the prophets who prophesied of Christ, then you were born and killed Christ himself. The same murderers came right back in their kids. They have always hated him, from their fathers to them.

“When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.” Why were they cut? Because they knew their fathers were murderers who killed the prophets that prophesied of Christ's coming. It made them furious, and that's when they killed him.

sense.text:
“And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation”. The angels here are the sons of God at the beginning of the Bible in Genesis: Seth's line, Adam's chosen righteous line of children.

“He hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” Remember the builders: the prophets and the seers, their eyes were covered with that darkness, to reject Christ, the black Messiah. They were reserved for that from the beginning: their fathers were murderers and they came out murderers too.

“Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication”. The angels of verse 6 did the exact same thing; that is why it says in like manner. They gave themselves over to fornication, “and going after strange flesh”, because the sons of God stepped outside their own line and married and dealt with Cain's lineage, the daughters of men. “Set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.”

precepts.why:
Regarding the fornication: “That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.” That is the fornication.

“And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.” I will cut his lifespan shorter because of this. So the sons of God went into fornication: they fell from their first estate. These are the ones reserved for judgment.

“For if God spared not the angels that sinned”: the angels that sinned are the sons of God in Genesis. “But cast them down to hell”: cast them down from their powerful estate, “and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment”.

They were rebellious, and they came right back as the same Pharisees, scribes and Sadducees who were in darkness. That's them, back again.

sense.text: “And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.” They were mad at the Messiah.

“Ye are they which justify yourselves before men”: going on podcasts, arguing back and forth with people to get fame, notoriety, publicity, attention. “But God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.” You want to be a content creator so bad; you want fame so bad.

“Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery”. Why does he say this here? Because that is what the Pharisees were doing. Going back to verse 14, they were covetous, and they were committing fornication by violating this very law.

“There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day”. The rich man is a parable about the Pharisees; they were the rich man. Lazarus was the disciples, us, the people under their rulership. The Pharisees were adulterers and fornicators, and the rich man Christ spoke of in the parable.
“And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.” Stop right there: from the east and west.

precepts.why: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth”. The many who come from the east and west are the seed of Israel, the sons and daughters gathered from the ends of the earth.

sense.text: “The chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders, and spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?”
“The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?” When John taught, was it of God or of men?

“And they reasoned with themselves”: they went into a huddle to answer the question. “If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?” If we say his teaching was from heaven, he'll ask why we rejected him.
“But and if we say, Of men”: if we say his doctrine was of man, that he was a fake Israelite camp, a regular guy, “all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.”
“They could not tell whence it was.” They couldn't answer whether he was a prophet or of men. “Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.”

“A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen”, and sent servant after servant for the fruit, and they beat them, entreated them shamefully and cast them out. The servants are the prophets: remember what we read earlier about them killing the prophets.
“I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.” They beat my servants; let me send my son, they won't harm him.
“This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.”

“He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.” They said no, because they knew he was talking about them. And the others he gives the vineyard to are us.

precepts.why:
So who are the others? “I sent unto you my servants the prophets, whom ye have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, saith the Lord.” “Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind doth stubble. And your children shall not be fruitful”: because their children are going to kill Christ. “For they have despised my commandment, and done the thing that is evil before me.”

“Your houses will I give to a people that shall come; which not having heard of me yet shall believe me; to whom I have shewed no signs, yet they shall do that I have commanded them. They have seen no prophets, yet they shall call their sins to remembrance, and acknowledge them.” That's about us.

“I take to witness the grace of the people to come, whose little ones rejoice in gladness”: his children, us. “And though they have not seen me with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they believe the thing that I say.” We have not seen Christ physically. Christ told Thomas, blessed is he that has not seen me and yet believed; that is talking about us.

“And now, brother, behold what glory; and see the people that cometh from the east: Unto whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob”, and the prophets down to “Malachy, which is called also an angel of the Lord.” These are called angels of God, going back to the sons of God in Genesis: angels refers to us.

“Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.” That's how you know these are the ones reserved for darkness: they speak evil. Christ asked whether John's baptism was of God or of men, and they said, if we say of God he will ask why we don't believe him, because they had spoken evil of John. John was a dignity. They spoke evil of Christ; he was a dignity. They spoke evil of the twelve, dignities.

sense.text: “The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son, And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.” He is talking to Israel at this time, to the elders.
“But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise”. These are the elders, the leaders: I don't care about their wedding. They did what they wanted to do.
“And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.” The remnant is the Pharisees and their fathers before them, who killed the prophets and tore them in pieces.

“But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.” When the Lord sent Rome to destroy us, he burned their behinds up and burned the city up along with them. They believed they were in good case when Rome came against us, and they got killed too.
“The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.” That's the Pharisees, the scribes, the Sadducees, the elders.

“Go ye therefore into the highways”: into the streets; go out there and teach them. They “gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good”: those who keep the commandments of God and those who are sinful.
“He saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment”: that's the bad. “And he was speechless”: no excuse.

“Cast him into outer darkness”, because he was reserved for darkness from the very beginning; that was their lot. There are those who are predestined for light and those who are predestined for darkness: the third and the two-thirds. “There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth”: that's nuclear fire, hellfire.

“For many are called, but few are chosen.” Few are the Lord's children. There are many Israelites, but not all Israel is of Israel: the first scripture read today. Many of our people are called, but few of them will be chosen out of that large abundance of our people scattered abroad.

precepts.why:
“But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government.” They despise being led, leadership. “Presumptuous are they, selfwilled”: they do what they want to do and don't care what the Bible says.

“They are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.” Why does he say it that way? Because you are supposed to be afraid: there is a consequence when you speak evil of dignities. When you say Paul was a false prophet, or call it racial idolatry, when you say John was a fake Israelite camp, when you disrespect Christ, Moses, the twelve disciples, bad things follow. Then the nations can be saved, we're not Israelites no more, we'll start wearing Khazar fringes and yarmulkes and speaking Yiddish: nation salvation enters your mind for speaking evil of dignities.

“And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words”.
